anomalies.observed: U10 and U11 are isolated CAN transceivers (CA-IS3050G). Their logic-side ground GND1 (pin 4) and bus-side ground GND2 (pin 5) are both connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For an isolated CAN transceiver, GND1 and GND2 must be on separate isolated ground nets to maintain galvanic isolation between the logic side and the CAN bus side.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The isolation barrier is shorted, so the CAN buses are not isolated. Ground loops, noise, and fault currents can pass between the logic and bus sides, defeating the purpose of the isolated transceivers.

anomalies.observed: C46 has value '22pF 100v' but its description and MPN (CC0603KRX7R0BB223) indicate a 22nF capacitor. The other three identical components in the same Ethernet termination network (C42, C44, C45) are all 22nF.
anomalies.expected: C46 should be 22nF to match the other three termination capacitors and the MPN/description.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "C46") (value "22pF 100v") ... (field (name "MPN") "CC0603KRX7R0BB223") (field (name "Description") " 100V 22nF X7R ±10% 0603 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS "))

anomalies.impact: If a 22pF capacitor is fitted, the Ethernet termination impedance will be incorrect, potentially causing signal integrity issues or link failures.

anomalies.observed: U21 (FT231XS) pin 13 (3V3OUT, an internal LDO output) is connected to the +3V3 net, which is also driven by U20 (TLV1117LV33) pin 2 (VO). U21 VCC (pin 15) and VCCIO (pin 3) are also on +3V3.
anomalies.expected: When the FT231XS is powered from an external 3.3V supply (VCC on +3V3), its 3V3OUT pin should be left unconnected to avoid contention between the internal LDO and the external regulator.
anomalies.impact: The internal LDO of the FT231XS may fight the external 3.3V regulator, potentially causing instability, increased current, or damage to the FT231XS.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies. The most critical is that the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have their logic-side and bus-side grounds shorted together, defeating the intended galvanic isolation. Additionally, C46 has a value mismatch (22pF vs 22nF) and U21's internal LDO output is tied to the external 3.3V rail, creating a power output conflict.
